card.name: Opening brackets and dashes in lists
card.fires_on: The opening parenthesis or dash right after a city name in an uppercase list of UK postal towns with postcode codes. It also fires on a leading digit in dose tables and section numbers.

modes.label: Postcode town lists
modes.description: Opening bracket or dash between uppercase UK town entries and their postcode area letters.

modes.label: Digits in dose tables
modes.description: A first digit of a dose figure or reference number in a dosing table or section cross-reference.
modes.example: 12.5 mg/day 75 mg/day SAD 12.5 mg/day 37.5 mg/day PMDD <<1>>2.5 mg/day 25

card.plain: It marks the punctuation that follows a town name in a postcode list, and sometimes the first digit of a dose number.
